strategyOverview.family: EMA crossover with ATR-based initial stop, break-even, and trailing stop
strategyOverview.style: Trend-following on EMA(12)/EMA(21) cross; exits via stop/trail only (no opposite-signal exit in code)
strategyOverview.barsEvaluated: Each closed 1m candle index i (loop starts at i=1)

indicators.warmup: First (period-1) bars padded with NaN; signals require finite EMA/ATR at bar i

entryExecution.description: Signal on bar i close; open at bar i+1 open with stop frozen from signal bar

entryLogic: passVolatilityFilter: minAtrFilter must be >0 to apply (winner=0 → always pass)
Read EMA short/long at i-1 and i; read ATR at i
Detect bullish or bearish crossover (see long/short conditions)
Queue or open position via signal()

initial.note: entryReference is signal bar close (nextOpen) or same-bar close (close mode)

intrabar.long: Exit if candle.low <= stopLoss (fill at stopLoss price)
intrabar.short: Exit if candle.high >= stopLoss (fill at stopLoss price)

stopLoss.trailingOverride: Trailing may ratchet stop only in favorable direction

positionSize.formula: qty = (balance * riskPct/100) / |entry - stop|; cap: (qty*entry)/leverage <= balance → qty = balance*leverage/entry

leverageLogic.usage: Caps notional: max position notional = balance * leverage
leverageLogic.note: Does not multiply PnL; only sizing cap in calcQty

breakEvenLogic.rule: If unrealized profit % >= breakEvenPct, set stopLoss = entryPrice and breakEvenActive=true

trailingStopLogic.updateLong: candidate = close * (1 - trailGap/100); stop = max(stop, candidate)
trailingStopLogic.updateShort: candidate = close * (1 + trailGap/100); stop = min(stop, candidate)

exitLogic.endOfBacktest: Force close at last candle close if still open

maxTradesPerDay.behavior: If maxTradesPerDay < 999, count entries per UTC day key YYYY-MM-DD; skip when count >= limit

cooldownReentry.rule: After exit at index x, block new entries until index >= x + cooldownCandles

liveBotState.balance: USDC wallet / account equity for sizing
liveBotState.position: null | { direction, entryTime, entryPrice, qty, stopLoss, trailingActive, breakEvenActive, entryFee }
liveBotState.pendingSignal: null | { direction, signalBarTime, stopLoss } for next-open execution
liveBotState.cooldownUntilBarIndex: integer bar index or timestamp of allowed next entry
liveBotState.diagnostics: counters optional: signals, crossovers, skippedByFilter, etc.

cacheAndStoredData.rollingCandles: At least max(emaLong, atrPeriod) + 2 closed 1m bars for SOLUSD
cacheAndStoredData.computedSeries: EMA(12), EMA(21), ATR(14) aligned to candle index
cacheAndStoredData.persistOptional: Last 500-1000 1m OHLCV for restart; last indicator values; open position snapshot
cacheAndStoredData.doNotPersist: Full trade history required only for analytics

pseudocode:
onEachClosedBar(i):
  runBar()  // fill pending at open, then manageExits
  if position: return
  if i < cooldownUntil: return
  if !passVolatilityFilter(): return  // minAtrFilter=0 → pass
  ps, pl = emaShort[i-1], emaLong[i-1]
  cs, cl = emaShort[i], emaLong[i]
  a = atr[i]
  if not finite(ps,cs,a): return
  bull = ps <= pl and cs > cl
  bear = ps >= pl and cs < cl
  if not bull and not bear: return
  stop = close - a*atrMult if bull else close + a*atrMult
  if abs(close-stop) < close*feeRate*minMoveVsFeeMult: return
  signal(direction=bull?long:short, stop)
  // nextOpen: pending fills at bar i+1 open

manageExits on each bar while position:
  if maxHold exceeded: close at close
  if takeProfitPct hit: close at close
  if profit% >= breakEvenPct: stop = entry
  if profit% >= trailStart: trailingActive = true
  if trailingActive: ratchet stop by trailGap from close
  if long and low <= stop: exit at stop
  if short and high >= stop: exit at stop
  on close: cooldownUntil = i + cooldownCandles
edgeCases: EMA/ATR NaN during warmup → no signal
Signal on last bar with nextOpen → no fill (no i+1)
qty capped by leverage may reduce risk below riskPct target
Same-bar: manageExits runs after pending fill on entry bar
Break-even and trailing both mutate stopLoss; stop check uses final stop
UTC day boundary for tradesToday uses candle.openTime ISO date slice
safetyChecks: Reject entry if qty <= 0 or stop invalid
Enforce max leverage notional cap before send order
Live: hard stop max account drawdown / daily loss outside strategy
Do not double-enter while position or pending exists
Round qty/price per O1 market lot size rules
debugLogs: EXIT {reason} price gross net fees balance
